subject: Quick details for the study group service
text: I know the first session came out better than I expected, and the quiz scores jumped after we switched to short problem sets. That is good news, but it also means I need to tighten the service plan before another student joins. Since we sat together in lecture and you just signed on as my first official client, can you send me the three things I flagged on the intake form? I need the best times for live sessions, the subjects you want prioritized, and whether you want recordings after each meeting. If the calendar is messy, bullet points are fine. I also want to confirm whether the shared notes should include the examples we solve together or only the practice questions. The unexpectedly strong turnout for the pilot meeting makes me think we can package this as a weekend review service, but I do not want to assume your preferences from one session. If you already have textbook links or old tests, attach them when you write back, even if they are rough scans. I am trying to avoid building the schedule around guesswork because the next two weeks are tight. Once I have those answers, I can draft the short contract and send it over. Please reply by tonight if possible. If any item is unclear, answer the parts you know and note the missing pieces. I will turn the rest into a simple proposal tomorrow.
